book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: CART GWCHOPE DANꞋ BZOJ POSTLW SAN PABLO C̱HE BEṈEꞋ CAꞋ ŽEꞋ CORINTO

content: Besezande' da' gota' c̱hegaque' gosaclene' beṉe' yoble
Beṉe' migw, chaclaže'to' ṉezele can' ba goclen Diosen' to cuen to cuen beṉe' ca' chesedop chesežag chesonxene' Criston' to to yež gan' mbane distritw Macedonian'.
Gocchgua yeḻa' yaše' yeḻa' zi' c̱hegaque', perw Diosen' bene' cont gwnita'chgüe' mbalaz ḻo' yic̱hjlažda'ogaquen' na' besyebechgüede' bosotobe' mechw xen cont gosaclene' beṉe' yoble.
Ṉezda' na' choa' diža' bosonežjochgüe' da' beseyažje beṉe' yoble ḻa'czḻa' bibi gota' c̱hegaque', na' con xbab c̱hegaczen' gosone' ca'.
Goseṉeyoede' güe'to' latje yosonežjue' mechw cont yesaclene' beṉe' ca' chesejnilaže' Diosen'.
Na' gosonche' can' bento' xbab yesone', ḻe zgua'tec goson cuingaque' ḻo na' X̱ancho Criston' na' ḻecze goson cuine' ḻo na' neto' dan' gosaclaže'chgüe' yesone' can' chazlaže' Diosen'.
Da'nan' ba gota'yoeto' Titon' yeyede' yeto gan' zoale cont gaclene' le'e yeyož gwtoble mechw dan' goclene' le'e gwzolao btoble cana'.

Güenchgua chonḻe chejnilaže'chguale Criston' na' choe'chguale xtižen', da' zan da' chejni'ile c̱he Diosen', chonchguale xšinen', na' chaquechgüele neto'. Ḻecze ḻe gon güenchgua na' ḻe gwtobe da' cheseyažje beṉe'.
Bi chona' byen gwnežjwle mechon', san chaclaža' gonḻe xbab še chaquele Diosen' na' še chaque ḻježle do laže'le can' goson beṉe' Macedonian' da' chesacde' Diosen' na' ḻježgaque'.

Ṉezele ḻeca nži'ilaže' X̱ancho Jesucriston' chio'. Da' chacde' chio' bcua'aṉe' yogo'ḻoḻ da' šagüe' da' de c̱he' gan' zoe' len Diosen' na' bide' golje' beṉe' yaše' yežlio nga, bedeyene' cont yogo' dan' de c̱he' gaquen c̱hecho naccho txen len ḻe'.
Nachen' gwzejni'ida' can' chacda' naquen güen gonḻe. Godgüiz goclaže'le gaclenḻe beṉe' yaše' ca' na' gwzolaole btoble mechon' do yic̱hj do laže'le.
Na' chacda' güen yeyož gwtoblen ṉa'a do yic̱hj do laže'le can' gwzolaole, na' gwnežjwle con ca zelao saque'le.
Note'tezcho še do laže'cho chaclaže'cho gwnežjwcho bi da' gwnežjwcho, Diosen' yebede' ḻa'czḻa' late'ze da' de da' gwnežjwchone'. Bi chṉabe' gwnežjwchone' da' bi de c̱hecho.
Bi žia' gonḻe cont bich bi yega'aṉ c̱hele na' gata' c̱he beṉe' yoble.

Con chaclaža' gata' da' chyažje yogo'le. Šlac ṉa'a de c̱he le'e, cheyaḻa' gaclenḻe beṉe' ca' cheseyažjde'. ¿C̱hixe še gwžin ža cate' gata' c̱hegaque' na' le'e chyažjele? Cana'chen' yesaclene' le'e cont gata' da' chyažje yogo'le.
Nach gac can' nyoj Xtiža' Diosen' žan: “Beṉe' botobe' da' zc̱ha'o, bitw ṉacho becho'oṉen c̱he', na' beṉe' botobe' late'ze, gota'cze da' byažjde'.”
Titon' na' beṉe' ḻježe' ca'
Chox̱clen Diosen' bene' cont Titon' zelaže'chgüe' gaclene' le'e con can' zelaža' neda'.
Na' cate' goša'ne' yedeṉe'e le'e da' yoble cont gaclenche' le'e, bebede', ḻe to gualaze' bene' xbab yeyede' gaclenche' le'e.

Na' chseḻa'to' yeto beṉe' ḻježcho len Titon'. Na' to cuen to cuen beṉe' ca' chesedop chesežag chesonxen Jesucriston' cheso'e diža' c̱he benga chseḻa'to', chesene' binḻo chyix̱jue'ede' diža' güen c̱he Jesucriston'.

Nachen' ḻecze gosebeje' ḻe' cont sa'lene' neda' cate' ša'a gan' že' beṉe' ḻježcho ca' šjasana' mechw dan' chtobcho. Na' gwnežjwcho mechon' cont gacxen X̱ancho Jesucriston' na' cont gwlo'ele chbele chaclen beṉe' ḻježle.
Yo'o yic̱hjto' gonto' da' nac güen lao X̱anchon' na' lao beṉac̱hen', ḻe mechw xenṉa', na' bi chaclaže'to' yesene' chonto' clele len ḻen.

Na' ḻecze chseḻa'to' yeto beṉe' ḻježcho len ḻegaque'. Zan ṉi'a ba ble'eto' chone' xšin Diosen' do yic̱hj do laže' na' ṉa'a ḻeca žan yide' gan' zoalen' da' ṉezde' zelaže'chguale gonḻe can' chazlaže' Diosen'.

Na' ca nac Titon', chone' xšin Diosen' txen len neda' cont chaclento' le'e. Na' beṉe' ca' yec̱hope, zjanite' chesone' cont Criston' chacxene', na' beṉe' ca' chesedop chesežag chesonxene' Jesucriston' gosebeje' ḻegaque' na' cheseseḻe' ḻegaque'.
Da'nan' chnia' ḻe gon güen len ḻegaque' cont beṉe' ca' chesonxene' Criston' to to yež yeseṉezde' chaquele ḻegaque', na' ḻe gwlo'e chonḻe güen can' gwnato' cate' be'to' diža' güen c̱hele.
